evidence.title: Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding for Low-Bit LLM Weight Repair

summary: Researchers have introduced Activation-Weighted Seeded Residual Coding, a technique that leverages activation data to more accurately reconstruct low-bit quantized weights in large language models. The approach improves model performance after aggressive quantization, offering a practical solution for efficient LLM deployment.
title: New Method Boosts Low-Bit LLM Weight Repair Using Activation-Weighted Residual Coding
